faq.question: What does Hulusi mean?

faq.question: What is the origin of Hulusi?
faq.answer: Hulusi is associated with Arabic. Hulusi is the Turkish form of Arabic خُلُوصِيّ (Khulūṣī), the relative form of خُلُوص (sincerity), used as a male given name.

faq.question: Is Hulusi an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form خُلُوصِي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Hulusi an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Hulusi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
